subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3967
title: Provides that the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court may impound funds and eliminate benefits available to a judge that are not compensation to which a judge is entitled under the Oregon Constitution.
headline: HB 3967 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3967 was introduced in the House on April 21, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
